from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's diluted earnings per share from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="The diluted earnings per share value; negative indicates loss")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the EPS value (e.g. '元/股')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial period this value covers")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEPSRecord]
